name: CN Tower
type: observation tower; architectural landmark; television tower
text: The CN Tower (French: Tour CN) is a 553.3-metre-high (1,815.3 ft) communications and observation tower in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Completed in 1976, it is located in downtown Toronto, built on the former Railway Lands. Its name "CN" refers to Canadian National, the railway company that built the tower.
